hooks.name: player_advancement_criterion_grant
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerAdvancementCriterionGrant)

rust_summary: A server player earned an advancement criterion (`native_player_advancement_criterion_grant`).
doc_summary: A server player earned one criterion of an advancement, after its progress was recorded: `native_player_advancement_criterion_grant(player, name, advancement, criterion)`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_advancement_criterion_grant@.
